title: Attituden ten aanzien van Duitsland 1997
authors: Dekker, H., Winkel, B., Rijksuniversiteit Leiden * Leiden (primary investigator)
descriptions: Perception of, sympathy for different European countries / values and beliefs / experiences with meeting people from England, France, Belgium and in particular Germany / watching foreign tv channels / knowledge about European countries in particular Germany / r'.s portrayal of man, nationalism, self-esteem, self-image, national pride, attitude to the (unification of) Europe. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ education/ religion
